query.description: Search string — matched by Telegram's server-side engine against filenames, audio titles, and performers

channel.description: Channel username (e.g. '@mychannel') or numeric ID to restrict search. Leave empty for global search across all of Telegram.

media_type.description: Restrict results to audio files, video/film files, or any media (default: 'any')

limit.description: Maximum results to return per media type pass (default 50).
